findings.highlight: polished to a mirror-like shine while it erodes away.
findings.evidenceJa: 鏡のように磨かれ曇り
findings.governingReading: 磨かれ曇り combines polishing and becoming clouded before progressive wearing away, part of the contradictory dream imagery.
findings.explanation: Mirror polishing retains erosion but loses clouding.

findings.evidenceJa: 呆然と、目の前にいるイリヤを観察する
findings.governingReading: The first-person narrator watches Illya before describing her; she has also separately observed him, mentioned in12.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s stunned observation becomes Illya staring at him.

findings.highlight: my right hand is grabbing my left arm.
findings.evidenceJa: 右手が左腕の布を掴んでいる
findings.governingReading: His right hand grips the wrapping on the left arm, relevant to Illya’s warning against removing it.
findings.explanation: Grasping the arm’s cloth becomes grasping the arm.

findings.governingReading: 不覚にも胸が is interrupted by her teasing, which brakes his racing heart.
findings.explanation: An involuntary stirring of his chest becomes feeling ashamed.

findings.highlight: adolescent young man who's in charge of this house.
findings.evidenceJa: 部屋の主たる思春期の少年
findings.governingReading: 部屋の主 refers to the adolescent whose room she entered.
findings.explanation: The room’s occupant becomes the person in charge of the house.

findings.evidenceJa: だから、危ないって、言ったんだ
findings.governingReading: He reuses his earlier dangerous warning as a strained excuse after hitting his head.
findings.explanation: That is why I warned you becomes anyway, it is dangerous.

findings.highlight: As for Western food... I can manage pancakes and stuff.
findings.evidenceJa: 洋菓子は……そうだな、ホットケーキぐらいなら、なんとか
findings.governingReading: 洋菓子 singles out sweets, with pancakes about the one thing he can manage.
findings.explanation: Limited Western-sweets competence becomes broader Western-food competence.

findings.highlight: replicates any weapon he sees as swords...
findings.evidenceJa: 視認した“武装”を複製し自らの剣とする
findings.governingReading: 複製し自らの剣とする concerns using copied armaments as his own weapons;36 explicitly retains replication of any viewed weapon.
findings.explanation: Replicating viewed armaments for his own use becomes replicating any weapon as swords.

findings.highlight: you can instantly recall his incantations
findings.evidenceJa: キチンとした起動呪文も思い起こせる
findings.governingReading: キチンとした qualifies the activation spell; deliberate intent allows remembering it, with no speed specification.
findings.explanation: Recalling a proper activation incantation becomes instantly recalling his incantations.
